change_summary: Add a complete-denominator candidate ledger around frozen NFL RUN IT v3 pricing: every attempted offer gets one row before any filter, malformed offers become retained rejection rows, qualifies and on_image are separate fields. New files only; frozen v3 runner and card are not modified.
assumptions: Pricing formulas and constants are copied from the frozen v3 runner; this PR does not tune or validate them.
Default legacy_note_rounding=True reproduces v3's one-decimal total-direction filter; full precision is a separate opt-in correction.
The on_image rule (top 20 by raw EV, max 3 props per game) was reconstructed from the v3 card image, not from frozen display code.
Private Week 11 parity was approximate (max abs diff 0.00035) because projections were recovered from frozen probabilities, not refit.

baseline.metric: attempted Week 11 offers missing from the frozen v3 candidate export
